senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (सहते) r. 4th cl. (सह्यति) 1st and 10th cls. (सहति साहयति.)
1 To bear, to endure, to suffer or support, to forbear, to have patience.
2 To be content or satisfied.
3 To be able.
With उत् prefixed,
1 To make effort or exertion, to persevere, to energize.
2 To be happy or delighted.
With प्र,
To be violent.
With वि,
To determine.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Patient, enduring, suffering, bearing.
m. (-हः)
The month Agrahāyaṇa.
mn. (-हः-हं)
Strength, power.
f. (-हा)
1 The earth.
2 The Aloe plant.
3 A sort of bean, commonly Mudgaparṇī.
4 A drug, commonly Nakhi.
5 A plant; also Daṇḍotpalā.
6 Barleria, (the white sort.)
7 The ichneumon plant or Rasan.
8 A medicinal sort of moon plant.
ind.
1 With, together with; a particle implying association, connexion;
2 Union, junction;
3 Increase, addition;
4 Presence, present time;
5 Completeness, entireness;
6 Resemblance, &c.
E.
षह to have patience, aff. अच्, fem. aff. टाप्.

m. (-रः)
A fragrant sort of mango.
E.
सह with, कृ to make, अण् aff.

f. (-ता)
Co-operation, assistance.
E.
सहकारिन्, and तल् aff.; also सहकारित्वं.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
An implement, an assistant or associate, that or who, by which or whom, any object is effected, &c.
E.
सह with, कृ to make, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-कृत्)
Assisting, an assister.
E.
सह, and कृत् who does.

mfn. (-त्वा-त्वा-त्व)
Co-operating, assisting.
E.
सह with, कृ to do, क्वनिप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Accompanied, associated.
E.
सह with, गत gone.

n. (-नं)
1 Going with, accompanying.
2 A woman's burning herself on the funeral pile with her deceased husband.
E.
सह with, गमन going.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Going with, accompanying.
f. (-नी)
A woman who burns herself with her husband's body.
E.
सह with, गामिन् who goes.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Accompanying, going or associating with, &c.
mf. (-रः-री)
Yellow Barleria.
m. (-रः)
1 A companion, a follower.
2 A surety.
f. (-री)
1 A wife.
2 A woman's female friend or confidence.
E.
सह with, चर to go, टच् aff.

m. (-रः)
A yellow sort of Barleria, (B. prionitis.)
E.
सह with आङ् before चर to go, aff. टच्; also सहचर.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
Accompanying, attending.
E.
सह with, चर to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Who or what accompanies, attends, associates with, &c.
E.
सह with, चर to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
A companion, an attendant.
E.
सह with, चारिन् who goes.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Co-existent, cognate, born or produced together.
2 Innate, inherent, natural.
m. (-जः)
1 A brother of whole blood.
2 The natural state or disposition.
E.
सह with, and ज born.

m. (-चः)
A friend by birth; as a sister's son, &c.
E.
सहज cognate, मिच friend.

m. (-रिः)
A natural enemy, one hostile by birth; as the son of the same father by another mother, the son of a paternal uncle, &c.
E.
सहज cognate, अरि an enemy.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Incidental, accidental, not inherent or innate, (in the dual it may imply both innate and adventitious.)
E.
सहज, and इतर other.

m. (-नः)
A person, unconnected by birth, born neither an enemy nor friend.
E.
सहज cognate, उदासीन a stranger.

n. (-त्वं).
1 Sufferance, endurance.
2 Association, union.
E.
सह patient, or with, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, सहता.

m. (-वः)
The youngest of the five Pāṇḍava princes.
f. (-वा)
1 A plant, a sort of Sida.
2 A twining shrub, (Echites frutescens.)
3 Another plant, also Daṇḍotpala.
f. (-वी)
1 A sort of Sida.
2 A shrub, bearing a fragrant seed, Priyangu.
E.
सह with देव who or what sports.

m. (-र्म्मः)
Community of duty, law, property, &c.
E.
सह with, धर्म्म duty.

mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि)
1 Following the same law, acknowledging the same obligations.
2 Possessing same or like properties.
f. (-णी)
A woman married according to the ritual of the Vedas.
E.
सह with, धर्म्म the law, इनि aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Patient, enduring.
n. (-नं)
Bearing, enduring.
E.
सह to bear, युच् or ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Sufferance, endurance.
E.
षह to bear, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Dancing together in a circle, &c.
E.
सह together, and नर्त्तन dancing.

m. (-लः)
A contemporary and friend.

n. (-नं)
Drinking together.
E.
सह with, पान drinking.

m. (-वी)
A friend, a companion, an adherent or partisan.
E.
सह with, भाव quality, इनि aff.

n. (-नं)
Eating in company.
E.
सह together, भोजन food.

n. (-णं)
Concremation, a widow's burning herself with the corpse of her husband.
E.
सह with, मरण dying.

mfn. (-ध्वा-ध्वा-ध्व)
Fighting with or along with.
m. (-ध्वा)
A brother in arms.
E.
सह, युध to fight, क्वनिप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Fighting with.
E.
सह, युध्वान fighting.

f. (-सा)
A sort of bean; see मुद्गपर्णी.
E.
सह with, रस juice.

m. (-रिः)
1 The sun.
2 A bull.
ind.
Resembling HARI or VIṢṆU.
E.
स for सह with, or समान same, हरि the deity.

m. (-र्षः)
1 Envy, emulation.
2 Pleasure, delight.
E.
स with, हर्ष pleasure.

m. (-हां)
1 The month Agrahāyaṇa, (Nov.-Dec.)
2 The winter season.
n. (-हः)
1 Strength, power.
2 Light.
E.
षह to bear, असुन् aff.

ind.
Quickly, precipitately, inconsiderately, without consideration or pause.
E.
षह to bear, असा aff.

n. (-सं)
1 Punishment, chastisement, fine.
2 Violence, the perpetration of any act of rapine or aggression.
3 Oppression, cruelty.
4 Hatred.
5 Rape, ravishment.
6 Boldness, daring.
7 Rashness.
8 Oblation with fire.
E.
सहस् strength, अण् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Seen quickly.
m. (-ष्टः)
An adopted son.
E.
सहसा quickly, दृष्ट seen.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Patient, enduring.
m. (-नः)
1 A peacock.
2 Sacrifice, oblation.
E.
षह to bear, असानच् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-नं)
Sitting on the same seat.
E.
सह with, आसन a seat.

m. (-स्यः)
The month Pauṣa, (Dec.-Jan.)
E.
सह to bear, यत् aff., form irr.

n. (-स्रं)
A thousand.

mfn. (-स्रः-स्री-स्रं)
1 Bought with a thousand.
2 Paid per thousand, as interest, duty, &c.
3 Relating or belonging to a thousand.
m. (-स्रः)
An army or detachment, a thousand strong.
n. (-स्रं)
An aggregate of many thousands.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and अण् aff.

m. (-णः)
The sun.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and किरण a ray.

ind.
Repeatedly, reiteratedly, a thousand or many times.
E.
सहस्र, and कृत्वसुच् aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Liberal, giving by thousands.
E.
सहस्र, and द who gives.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus pelorius, BUC.)
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and दंष्ट्र tooth.

m. (-ष्ट्री)
A sheat fish: see the last.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, दंष्ट्र a tooth, and इनि aff.

m. (-दृक्)
INDRA.
E.
सहस्र, and दृश् the eye.

m. (-दोः)
KĀRTAVĪRYA, a prince so named.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and दोस् the arm.

ind.
In a thousand ways.
E.
सहस्र, and धाच् aff.

m. (-रः)
The discus of VIṢṆU.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and धार an edge.

m. (-नः)
INDRA.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and नयन the eye.

m. (-त्रः)
INDRA.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and नेत्र the eye.

m. (-तिः)
The governor of a district, or of a thousand villages.
E.
सहस्र, and पति chief.

n. (-त्रं)
A lotus.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-त् or -द्)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and पाद् for पाद a foot.

m. (-दः)
1 The sun.
2 VIṢṆU.
3 A sort of duck.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and पाद a foot.

m. (-गः)
A period of a thousand ages.
E.
सहस्र, and युग an age.

m. (-श्मिः)
The sun.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and रश्मि a ray.

n. (-म)
A blanket.
E.
सहस्र, and रोमन् hair.

m. (-नः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
सहस्र, a thousand, and वदन a face.

f. (-र्य्या)
A bent grass, (Panicum dactylon, the Agrostis linearis of LINNÆIS.)
E.
सहस्र a thousand, वीर्य्य splendor.

n. (-धि)
Asafoetida.
m. (-धी)
A sort of cane, (Calamus fasciculatus.)
E.
सहस्र a thousands, and वेधिन् what pierces.

ind.
By a thousand or thousands, thousand-fold.
E.
सहस्र, and शसि aff.

m. (-रः)
The Vindhya mountain.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and शिखर a crest.

m. (-श्वः)
The car of INDRA.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, हरि green, and अश्व a horse.

m. (-शुः)
The sun.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and अंशु a ray.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
Thousand-eyed; used figuratively, vigilant, all-perceiving, all-inspecting, all-powerful.
m. (-क्षः)
INDRA.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, and अक्ष the eye: INDRA having been covered over with marks resembling the female organ, in consequence of a curse of GAUTAMA, those marks were changed subsequently to eyes by the relenting saint.

m. (-तिः)
The governor of a district or chief over a thousand villages.
E.
सहस्र, and अधिपति ruler.

n. (-रं)
The top of the head, the seat of the soul.
E.
सहस्र, and अर a spoke.

m. (-रः)
A fine of from five hundred to a thousand Paṇas.
E.
सहस्र, and अवर below.

mfn. (-स्री-स्रिणी-स्रि)
Having a thousand.
m. (-स्री)
1 A body of a thousand men, &c.
2 Commander or prefect of a thousand.
E.
सहस्र a thousand, इनि aff.

m. (-यः)
1 A companion, a follower, an adherent.
2 A patron, a helper.
3 A sort of drug and perfume, commonly Gahantāpārali.
4 The ruddy goose.
E.
सह with, इण् to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Causing or enabling to endure.
E.
षह to bear, causal form, साहि, and श aff.

n. (-य्यं)
1 Friendship, fellowship.
2 Help, succour.
3 Alliance.
E.
सहाय a friend, ष्यञ् aff.

f. (-ता)
1 A multitude of companions, a company of associates or followers.
2 Association, assistance, friendship.
E.
सहाय a companion, तल् aff. of number, or the abstract.

n. (-त्वं)
Fellowship, companionship, friendship.
E.
सहाय a companion, त्व aff. of the quality.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Befriended, assisted, accompanied.
E.
सहाय, and मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-रः)
The mango.
E.
षह to bear, आरन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
Well, convalescent.
E.
सह with, आरोग्य health.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
1 Having one object.
2 Synonymous, having the same meaning.
E.
सह with, अर्थ object, &c.

mfn. (-र्द्दः-र्द्दा-र्द्दं)
Tender, affectionate.
E.
स with, हार्द्द affection.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Accompanied by, in company with, associated with, &c.
2 Borne, endured.
n. adv. (-तं)
With, together with.
E.
सह with, इतच् aff.; or षह to bear, क्त aff., with इट् augment.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Bearing, enduring.
E.
सह to bear, तृच् aff.

n. (-त्रं)
Patience, endurance.
E.
षह to suffer, and इत्र aff.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
Patient, enduring, resigned.
E.
षह to bear, इष्णुच् aff.

f. (-ता)
Patience, resignation.
E.
तल affix of the abstract, added to the preceding.

m. (-रिः)
The sun.
f. (-रिः)
The earth.
E.
षह to bear, उरिन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Good-hearted.
m. (-यः)
A Paṇḍita, a learned man.
E.
स with, हृदय a heart.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Sportive, playing.
E.
स with हेल sport.

f. (-क्तिः)
A figure of rhetoric; either the employment of a word in a double meaning, or connecting different circumstances in one sentence by the use of the term सह with, along with.
E.
सह with, उक्ति saying.

m. (-जः)
A hut of leaves, &c. inhabited by ascetics.

m. (-ढः)
The son of a woman pregnant at the time of her marriage.
1 A thief caught with stolen property upon him.
E.
सह with, ऊढा a bride; or स with, होढ stolen goods.

m. (-जः)
The son of a woman pregnant at the time of marriage.
E.
स with, ऊढा a bride, ज born.

m. (-रः)
A brother of whole blood, one by the same father and mother.
E.
सह with, उदर the belly.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Said or declared, comprehensively or collectively.
E.
सह with, उदित said.

m. (-रः)
A saint, a pure or pious man.
E.
सह to bear, ओरन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-लं)
Violence, aggression.
E.
सहस् and वल, both meaning power, strength.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Dwelling or abiding with, being together with.
E.
सह, and उषित abiding.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
1 To be borne or suffered.
2 Equal or adequate to.
3 Sweet, agreeable.
4 Powerful, strong.
n. (-ह्यं)
Health, convalescence.
m. (-ह्यः)
One of the principal ranges of the mountains of India; the mountainous country on the north-west side of the Peninsula or towards Poonah, &c., and in which the Godāvarī river takes its rise.
E.
षह to bear, aff. यत्.

n. (-ह्यं)
Society, conjunction.
E.
सह with, together with, aff. of the abstract ष्यञ्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Proud, arrogant.
2 United with the principle of egotism.
E.
स with, अहङ्कार pride, &c.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Company, association, society, fellowship.
E.
सह with, चर going, aff. ष्यञ्.

n. (-कं)
Friendship, fellowship.
E.
साहय a friend, aff. वुञ्.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A name of VIKRAMĀDITYA.
E.
साहस violence, अङ्क a mark.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Castigatory, inflicted as punishment.
2 Perpetrated by violence.
3 Violent, felonious, rapacious, brutal, cruel.
4 Impetuous, rash.
5 Bold, daring.
m. (-कः)
A robber, a free-booter.
E.
साहस violence, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
1 Violent, ferocious.
2 Rash.
3 Daring, bold.
E.
साहस, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Intent on violence, brutal, ferocious.
E.
साहस, एक alone, रस taste, and ठञ् aff.

nf. (-त्यं-ती)
Society, association, connexion, combination.
n. (-त्यं)
Poetry, belles-lettres.
E.
सहित with, together with, aff. ष्यञ्

m. (-कृत्)
A companion.
E.
साह्य society, कृत् who makes.

m. (-यः)
Fighting animals, (as cocks, &c.) for sport or money.
E.
स with, आह्वय challenging.
